Agenda #1: Shareholders approved the 2025 Annual Report and audited Consolidated Financial Statements, granting full discharge of responsibility to the Board of Directors and Board of Commissioners. This included the ratification of the PUMK Financial Statements audited by Purwanto Susanti & Surja.
Agenda #2: The meeting approved the allocation of Rp56.65 trillion in net profit, designating Rp52.10 trillion for cash dividends (Rp346 per share) and Rp4.55 trillion for retained earnings. The remaining cash dividend to be paid is Rp209 per share, following an interim dividend distributed in January 2026.
Agenda #3: Authority was delegated to the majority Series B Shareholder and the Board of Commissioners to determine salaries, allowances, and performance-based remuneration for the Board of Directors and Commissioners. These determinations cover the 2025 performance year and the 2026 financial year.
Agenda #4: Shareholders approved appointing Purwanto Susanti dan Surja (Ernst & Young Global) to audit the 2026 Financial Statements and PUMK Program reports. The Board of Commissioners was authorized to determine audit fees and appoint substitute accountants if necessary, subject to Series B Shareholder approval.
Agenda #5: Authority was delegated to the Board of Commissioners, subject to coordination with Series A Dwiwarna Shareholders, to approve the 2026-2030 Long Term Corporate Plan and 2027 Work Plan and Budget.
Agenda #6: The meeting formally accepted the realization reports for the Sustainable Social Bonds I Phase I (2025) and Phase II (2026).
Agenda #7: Shareholders approved amending the Articles of Association to reclassify 806,109,768 Series B shares into Series A Dwiwarna shares to comply with Law No. 16 of 2025.

agm.agm_result:
Agenda #1: Shareholders approved the 2025 Annual Report, audited consolidated financial statements including 2023-2024 restatements, and granted a discharge of liability to the Board of Directors and Commissioners. The resolution notes that management remains liable for any proven legal violations or undisclosed actions during their tenure, particularly regarding ongoing investigations by the SEC and DOJ.
Agenda #2: The meeting approved a total cash dividend of Rp21,999,902,180,685, representing a 123.5% payout ratio sourced from the 2025 net profit and retained earnings. The Board of Directors is authorized to manage the payment schedule, taxation, and technical implementation.
Agenda #3: Authority was granted to the majority Series B Shareholder and the Board of Commissioners to determine the 2026 salaries, benefits, and 2025 performance-based remuneration for the company's management. This covers compensation for both the Board of Directors and the Board of Commissioners.
Agenda #4: The Board of Commissioners, subject to Series B Shareholder approval, was authorized to appoint a Public Accounting Firm to audit the 2026 consolidated financial statements and the Micro and Small Business Funding Program. This authority includes setting audit fees and appointing replacements if the primary auditor cannot complete the task.
Agenda #5: Shareholders approved a share buyback program with a maximum budget of Rp4,000,000,000,000, including all related execution costs and regulatory compliance. The Board of Directors is authorized to implement or terminate the program in accordance with prevailing regulations.
Agenda #6: The meeting delegated authority to the Board of Commissioners, with written approval from Series B Shareholders, to approve the 2026-2030 Long-Term Plan (RJPP) and the 2027 Work Plan and Budget (RKAP). The process must align with good corporate governance and government policy synchronization.
Agenda #7: Shareholders approved amendments to the Articles of Association to align business activities with KBLI 2025 and reclassify 516,023,535 Series B shares into Series A Dwiwarna shares. The Board of Directors was granted authority to execute all necessary legal and notarial documentation to finalize these changes.
Agenda #8: The meeting approved the dismissal of Rionald Silaban and Silmy Karim and appointed Edwin Hidayat Abdullah as Commissioner and Anthony Leong as Independent Commissioner. The new management composition was established with a nine-member Board of Directors led by Dian Siswarini and an eight-member Board of Commissioners led by Angga Raka Prabowo.

Agenda #1: Shareholders approved the 2025 annual report and audited financial statements, granting full discharge to the Board of Directors and Commissioners for their 2025 duties.
Agenda #2: The meeting approved the 2026 honorarium for Commissioners and delegated authority to the Nomination and Remuneration Committee to set specific salaries and bonuses for both boards.
Agenda #3: Shareholders approved appointing Purwanto, Susanti dan Surja (Ernst & Young Global Limited) to audit the company's 2026 consolidated financial statements.
Agenda #4: The company presented a report regarding the realization of the use of proceeds to shareholders, which required no formal resolution.
Agenda #5: The company reported the conclusion of its share buyback period which ran from June 19, 2025, to June 18, 2026.
Agenda #6: Shareholders approved renewing the authority to issue up to 1.5% of paid-up capital annually for 10 years for employee and management share programs.
Agenda #7: The meeting approved amending the Articles of Association to increase issued and paid-up capital for the Share Ownership Program and authorized the Board of Commissioners to execute the issuance.
Agenda #8: Shareholders approved a share buyback plan for 2026-2027 with a maximum budget allocation of Rp3,500,000,000,000.
Agenda #9: The meeting approved adjusting the company's purpose and objectives in Article 3 of the Articles of Association to align with the 2025 Indonesia Standard Industrial Classification.
Agenda #10: Marjorie Tiu Lao was reappointed as Independent Commissioner with a term effective until the 2029 Annual General Meeting of Shareholders.
Agenda #11: Agus D.W. Martowardojo was reappointed as President Commissioner with a term effective until the 2029 Annual General Meeting of Shareholders.
Agenda #12: Santoso Kartono was reappointed as a Commissioner with a term effective until the 2029 Annual General Meeting of Shareholders.
Agenda #13: The Board of Directors was authorized to notarize the new composition of the Board of Commissioners and Directors and notify the relevant authorities.
Agenda #14: The company utilized a multiple voting share structure with Series A and Series B shares to determine meeting quorums and voting rights.
